478.l.39751.t.2.name: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw

recap.headline: MONSTARS Ride Hunter And White Mambas' Regret
recap.subhead: MONSTARS lead Thug Life 6-4 only because of a De'Andre Hunter pickup the White Mambas cut loose on November 16.

zingers.line: De'Andre Hunter's 15 points, 8 assists and 1 steal flipped AST and ST; without that pickup, Thug Life would be winning 5-4.
They cut De'Andre Hunter, who now carries MONSTARS with 8 assists, then cut Jordan Poole, who has 31 points for Thug Life.
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander dropped 38 points and 4 threes from their bench, while a 8-1 lead did all the work anyway.

zingers.team: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw
zingers.line: Lost the night 9-1 to BrookynDynasty, and James Harden went 5-of-14 for 21 points and sank another FG% deficit.
Kelly Oubre Jr. hit 4 threes for 20 points and Mikel Brown Jr. added 17, so the Beard & Klaw drop-sheet got robbed.
Deni Avdija hit 31 points with 5 threes and Derik Queen shot 5-for-9, yet three pickups in the Anfernee Simons class combined for three points.
Trail Gopher Gold 3-7 with 4 fewer starts left, and Buddy Hield's 17 points and 4 threes only changed BLK at best.

night: Jaden McDaniels went for 34 points, 10 rebounds, 6 assists and 4 threes for Thug Life, the best line of the night, and Thug Life still lost.
James Harden shot 5-of-14 for 21 points and 3 threes for Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw, the worst brick on the board in a 9-1 loss.
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander posted 38 points, 7 assists and 4 threes on 13-of-30 shooting for Adam Silver Dez Nuts, who left him on the bench.
Christian Anderson Jr. hit 6 threes for 25 points on 9-of-12 shooting. He is still on the wire, as are Kenrich Williams and Jalen Slawson.
MONSTARS beat Thug Life 6-4 behind Tyler Herro's 32 and Scottie Barnes' 31; Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw lost 9-1 to BrookynDynasty.
